sn48.37:2.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ sātaṃ, kāyasamphassajaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
sn48.37:6.2: yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
sn48.37:7.1: tatra bhikkhave, yañca sukhindriyaṃ yañca somanassindriyaṃ, sukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā. yañca dukkhindriyaṃ yañca domanassindriyaṃ,
sn48.37:7.2: tatra bhikkhave, dukkhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā.
sn48.37:7.3: tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ, adukkhamasukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā.
